briefs.brief: 原创科幻电影海报：深空黑背景中，一艘细长的跃迁飞船从画面左下方朝右上方穿过蓝色星门，尾迹拉出冷白色弧线。海报上方居中显示中文主标题「归零之后」，下方居中显示中文副标题「最后一次跃迁」。文字必须清晰、准确、可读，简体中文字形不能出错。
constraints: 必须准确显示「归零之后」与「最后一次跃迁」
主标题位于上方居中，副标题位于下方居中
同一题材的所有来源共用同一 seed

Lower center: the exact Simplified Chinese subtitle "最后一次跃迁", smaller, widely tracked, white. No other copy. promptVariants.project: 写实环境人像，七十岁东亚女性陶艺师坐在旧木凳上，身体略向工作台前倾，灰白短发在耳后别起，脸上有自然皱纹和常年劳累形成的细纹，神情专注平静。她穿着深靛蓝亚麻围裙和卷起袖口的米色衬衫，双手捧着一只未完全修整的青瓷茶壶，右手拇指轻压壶肩，左手托住壶底，指节、指甲边缘和指腹的陶泥都清晰可见。背景是温暖杂乱但有序的陶艺工作室，木架上摆着素坯和釉料罐，左侧窗光斜入，暖色侧光照亮皮肤、陶土和青瓷釉面。真实皮肤纹理、自然手部解剖、浅景深、纪实摄影，无文字、无水印。
promptVariants.gold: Photorealistic environmental portrait of a seventy-year-old East Asian female ceramic artist seated on an old wooden stool, leaning slightly toward her workbench. Short silver hair tucked behind her ears, deeply weathered skin, natural wrinkles, calm focused eyes. She wears a dark indigo linen apron over a beige shirt with rolled sleeves. Her hands hold a celadon teapot in progress: right thumb gently presses the shoulder, left palm supports the base. Anatomically correct fingers, visible knuckles, short clean nails, clay slip along the fingertips. Warm late-afternoon window light from camera left, textured skin, wet clay, crackled celadon glaze, wooden tools, blurred shelves of bisque ware and glaze jars, shallow depth of field, editorial documentary photography, no text, no watermark.
promptVariants.official-skill: A realistic environmental portrait of a seventy-year-old female ceramic artist in a working pottery studio. She sits on a worn wooden stool, leaning forward with quiet concentration. Her grey hair is pinned loosely behind her ears, and her face has natural deep lines and weathered skin. She wears a dark indigo linen apron over a beige shirt with rolled sleeves. Both hands are visible as she refines a celadon teapot: one palm cradles the base, the other thumb smooths the shoulder. Her knuckles, short nails and clay-stained fingertips are clearly defined. Warm side light enters from a window on the left, revealing wet clay, the teapot's pale green glaze and the grain of the workbench. Shelves of bisque pieces and glaze jars soften in the background. Natural documentary photography, restrained earth tones, shallow depth of field, no text or watermark.

promptVariants.gold: Cinematic 35mm night street photograph outside a convenience store in heavy rain. Exactly three people and one dog. On the left, a young woman in a saturated yellow raincoat holds a clear umbrella with her right hand and receives a white shopping bag with her left, her body angled toward the center. In the center, a middle-aged man in a dark trench coat turns toward her and hands over the bag with his right hand, left hand in his pocket. On the right, a teenager crouches on the wet pavement and fastens a red leash to a seated black-and-white dog; the dog looks toward the other two people. No extra pedestrians. Warm white light spills from the storefront; cyan, magenta and orange neon signs reflect in long streaks across puddles. Visible rain, fabric sheen, breath mist, anatomically correct hands, realistic reflections, shallow cinematic depth.
